examples.title: Runs filter bar
examples.description: Status segments with counts, a multiple choice "Started by" chip that matches any selected origin, a single choice "Agent" chip, and a search field. Narrow the window to see the segments fold into a select, then into a Filter menu.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { type AppliedFilter, type FacetDefinition, FilterBar } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  const segments = [
    { value: 'all', label: 'All', count: 19 },
    { value: 'waiting', label: 'Waiting on you', count: 2 },
    { value: 'running', label: 'Running', count: 0 },
    { value: 'done', label: 'Done', count: 15 },
    { value: 'failed', label: 'Failed', count: 1 },
    { value: 'canceled', label: 'Canceled', count: 1 },
  ];

  const facets: FacetDefinition[] = [
    {
      type: 'choice',
      key: 'startedBy',
      label: 'Started by',
      options: [
        { value: 'you', label: 'You', count: 0 },
        { value: 'chats', label: 'Chats', count: 5 },
        { value: 'schedules', label: 'Schedules', count: 4 },
        { value: 'goals', label: 'Goals', count: 8 },
        { value: 'interborough', label: 'Interborough', count: 2 },
        { value: 'workflows', label: 'Workflows', count: 0 },
        { value: 'agents', label: 'Agents', count: 0 },
      ],
    },
    {
      type: 'choice',
      key: 'agent',
      label: 'Agent',
      multiple: false,
      options: [
        { value: 'assistant', label: 'Assistant' },
        { value: 'tool-runner', label: 'Tool runner' },
      ],
    },
  ];

  let segmentValue = $state('all');
  let appliedFilters = $state<AppliedFilter[]>([
    { key: 'agent', value: 'tool-runner', label: 'Agent' },
  ]);
  let searchQuery = $state('');

  function setFilter(key: string, values: readonly string[]) {
    const facet = facets.find((candidate) => candidate.key === key);
    const rest = appliedFilters.filter((filter) => filter.key !== key);
    appliedFilters =
      values.length === 0
        ? rest
        : [...rest, { key, value: values.join(','), label: facet?.label ?? key, values }];
  }
</script>

<FilterBar
  aria-label="Run filters"
  {segments}
  {segmentValue}
  {facets}
  {appliedFilters}
  {searchQuery}
  searchPlaceholder="Search runs"
  onSegmentChange={(value) => (segmentValue = value)}
  onSearchChange={(query) => (searchQuery = query)}
  onFacetChange={(key, value) => setFilter(key, value === '' ? [] : [value])}
  onFacetValuesChange={setFilter}
  onFilterRemove={(key) => setFilter(key, [])}
/>

examples.title: Workflows filter bar
examples.description: Three segments, one "Starts" add-facet chip and a search field on one row. With "Problems" chosen the segments read "Status: Problems 1" below the wide layout.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { type AppliedFilter, type FacetDefinition, FilterBar } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  const segments = [
    { value: 'all', label: 'All', count: 3 },
    { value: 'paused', label: 'Paused', count: 1 },
    { value: 'problems', label: 'Problems', count: 1 },
  ];

  const facets: FacetDefinition[] = [
    {
      type: 'choice',
      key: 'starts',
      label: 'Starts',
      multiple: false,
      options: [
        { value: 'schedule', label: 'On a schedule' },
        { value: 'manual', label: 'When you start it' },
      ],
    },
  ];

  let segmentValue = $state('all');
  let appliedFilters = $state<AppliedFilter[]>([]);
  let searchQuery = $state('');

  function setStarts(value: string) {
    appliedFilters = value === '' ? [] : [{ key: 'starts', value, label: 'Starts' }];
  }
</script>

<FilterBar
  aria-label="Workflow filters"
  {segments}
  {segmentValue}
  {facets}
  {appliedFilters}
  {searchQuery}
  searchPlaceholder="Search workflows"
  searchAriaLabel="Search workflows"
  onSegmentChange={(value) => (segmentValue = value)}
  onSearchChange={(query) => (searchQuery = query)}
  onFacetChange={(_key, value) => setStarts(value)}
  onFilterRemove={() => setStarts('')}
/>

examples.title: Schedules filter bar
examples.description: Segments that partition the list, a "Missed runs" toggle chip with a warning dot beside them (not a fourth segment, because a schedule can be both active and missed), and "Agent" and "Workflow" chips. No search field.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { type AppliedFilter, type FacetDefinition, FilterBar } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  const segments = [
    { value: 'all', label: 'All', count: 4 },
    { value: 'active', label: 'Active', count: 3 },
    { value: 'paused', label: 'Paused', count: 1 },
  ];

  const facets: FacetDefinition[] = [
    { type: 'toggle', key: 'missed', label: 'Missed runs', count: 1 },
    {
      type: 'choice',
      key: 'agent',
      label: 'Agent',
      multiple: false,
      options: [
        { value: 'assistant', label: 'Assistant' },
        { value: 'tool-runner', label: 'Tool runner' },
      ],
    },
    {
      type: 'choice',
      key: 'workflow',
      label: 'Workflow',
      multiple: false,
      options: [
        { value: 'release-notes', label: 'Release notes' },
        { value: 'triage-inbox', label: 'Triage inbox' },
      ],
    },
  ];

  let segmentValue = $state('all');
  let appliedFilters = $state<AppliedFilter[]>([]);

  function setFilter(key: string, value: string) {
    const facet = facets.find((candidate) => candidate.key === key);
    const rest = appliedFilters.filter((filter) => filter.key !== key);
    appliedFilters = value === '' ? rest : [...rest, { key, value, label: facet?.label ?? key }];
  }
</script>

<FilterBar
  aria-label="Schedule filters"
  searchVisible={false}
  {segments}
  {segmentValue}
  {facets}
  {appliedFilters}
  onSegmentChange={(value) => (segmentValue = value)}
  onFacetChange={setFilter}
  onFilterRemove={(key) => setFilter(key, '')}
/>

examples.title: Search and select facets
examples.description: Two separate single-choice selects beside a search field, as a memory list uses them: "Kind: All" and "Written by: Anyone". A bar of selects has nothing to collapse, so it stacks in a narrow container instead.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { type AppliedFilter, type FacetDefinition, FilterBar } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  const facets: FacetDefinition[] = [
    {
      type: 'select',
      key: 'kind',
      label: 'Kind',
      options: [
        { value: 'fact', label: 'Fact' },
        { value: 'how-to', label: 'How-to' },
      ],
    },
    {
      type: 'select',
      key: 'writer',
      label: 'Written by',
      placeholder: 'Anyone',
      options: [
        { value: 'you', label: 'You' },
        { value: 'tool-runner', label: 'Tool runner' },
      ],
    },
  ];

  let appliedFilters = $state<AppliedFilter[]>([]);
  let searchQuery = $state('');

  function setFilter(key: string, value: string) {
    const facet = facets.find((candidate) => candidate.key === key);
    const rest = appliedFilters.filter((filter) => filter.key !== key);
    appliedFilters = value === '' ? rest : [...rest, { key, value, label: facet?.label ?? key }];
  }
</script>

<FilterBar
  aria-label="Memory filters"
  {facets}
  {appliedFilters}
  {searchQuery}
  searchPlaceholder="Search memories"
  onSearchChange={(query) => (searchQuery = query)}
  onFacetChange={setFilter}
/>

examples.title: Disabled state
examples.description: Every control is disabled when disabled=true: the segments, the chips, the selects and the search field.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { type FacetDefinition, FilterBar } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  const facets: FacetDefinition[] = [
    {
      type: 'choice',
      key: 'agent',
      label: 'Agent',
      multiple: false,
      options: [{ value: 'tool-runner', label: 'Tool runner' }],
    },
  ];
</script>

<FilterBar
  aria-label="Disabled filter bar"
  segments={[
    { value: 'all', label: 'All', count: 3 },
    { value: 'failed', label: 'Failed', count: 1 },
  ]}
  {facets}
  appliedFilters={[{ key: 'agent', value: 'tool-runner', label: 'Agent' }]}
  disabled
/>
